draft_text: Ferrule generally achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT across the six-dataset tabular suite.
revised_text: Ferrule achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT on all six datasets in the tabular suite.
rationale: T1 shows Ferrule higher than Arbor-GBT on all six datasets (r1–r6). The claim "generally" understates this complete result. No statistical test is reported, so no significance claim is made, which is fine. The evidence supports a stronger statement: Ferrule was higher on every dataset.
